caption:
Automate it or keep it human? A quick AI quiz for small business owners

5 everyday tasks, 2 questions. How did you score?

My rule of thumb: automate it if it's repetitive, easy to check and cheap to get wrong. Keep it human when trust, money or feelings are on the line. Most tasks sit in the middle: AI drafts, you decide.

The review reply from the post, if you want to try it:

"Draft a calm reply to this review. No promises. Leave [FIX] for me to fill in. Review: [PASTE REVIEW]"

Remove the customer's contact details before you paste anything.
